intro: We currently hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published Animation - UG college in India. This page lists the top Animation - UG colleges in India with fees 2026 from that record.
Until more fees are verified, treat this as a starting note on the one published college, not as a complete map of undergraduate animation in India.
listLead: The only college on this fee list is Sharda University in Greater Noida, with a recorded B.Sc in Animation and VFX. If you are comparing other campuses, you will need to read their official fee notices directly, because they are not on this list yet.
snapshot: Because this list has fewer than five colleges, we do not quote a median fee here. The recorded fee for the Sharda University programme is in our records as ₹1.40 lakh–₹1.49 lakh for a three-year course.
Use the wider list of top Animation - UG colleges in India 2026 on the course listing page if you want campuses that do not yet have a fee in this article.
firstCollegesLead: Sharda University, Greater Noida, is a private university in our records, and the card shows B.Sc in Animation and VFX over three years. We do not hold a placement figure for this programme in the current file.
Confirm the current-year fee, hostel charges and admission test on the official Sharda University notice before you apply.
